title: You're Not Lazy — Your Brain Is Scared 🧠
description: You're not lazy. Your brain is terrified of big tasks — and there's a two-minute fix. #procrastination #productivity #psychology #2minuterule

beats.text: You're not lazy. Your brain is genuinely terrified of big tasks — and there's a two-minute fix.
beats.visual_prompt: a tiny human figure staring up at an enormous looming mountain made of clocks, paperwork and glowing screens, dark cinematic atmosphere, purple rim light

beats.text: It's called the two-minute rule. Shrink any task until it takes two minutes or less. That's it.
beats.visual_prompt: a giant glowing task list being sliced by a beam of light down to one tiny card, dark background, cyan accent light

beats.text: 'Write the essay' becomes 'open the document.' 'Get fit' becomes 'put on your shoes.'
beats.visual_prompt: a pair of running shoes glowing on a dark floor with a single spotlight, minimalist cinematic

beats.text: Here's why it works: your brain resists starting, not doing. Two minutes sneaks straight past the fear response.
beats.visual_prompt: a stylized translucent human brain with a glowing golden key sliding into it, dark navy background, dramatic lighting

beats.text: And motivation doesn't create action — action creates motivation. Once you start, momentum does the rest.
beats.visual_prompt: a small snowball rolling downhill becoming a massive avalanche, motion blur, dark blue winter twilight

beats.text: So pick one task you've been avoiding. Shrink it to two minutes. Do it now. Follow for a new brain hack every day.
beats.visual_prompt: a glowing countdown timer hitting zero with rays of golden light bursting outward, dark background
